vibe.verdict: Every line is true and the big gags print (franks and beans, hair gel, Norm the pizza boy, 'not lite beer, beer'), but a 1985 prom serving Miami Cuban sliders mixes up its own timeline, and the notes are flat stubs like 'Rolled in pecans.'
missing: Puffy, Magda's dog, on speed and then in a full body cast (only a wink)
Pat Healy's spy notes: 'Tight little package... affirmative'
The hitchhiker and his seven-minute abs
Have you seen my baseball? (only a footer nod)
Mary's wish list in full: 36 holes of golf and sausage hot dogs
ideas: Swap 'Miami Cuban sliders' (Miami is 13 years after this prom) for a prom-night dish tied to Woogie or Warren's baseball
Swap 'Prom night cheese ball and crackers' note 'Rolled in pecans.' for a Puffy the dog joke
Swap 'Mary asks Ted to the prom.' on the punch for 'Is it the frank or the beans?' (Charlie at the bathroom door)
Swap the footer 'Prices subject to change.' for 'Have you seen my baseball?'
